thread:
Alice W: :rotating_light: seeing a spike of 500s on /v1/chat/generate since ~09:03 UTC. Starts right after automated pin rollout for model 'os-superchat-2026-v3'. Can someone take a look?
incident-bot: Paging Carol (oncall) and Dev Runtime due to incident severity P1. Alert: 12% error rate on chat route for tenant: AcmePayments.
Carol (oncall): I'm on it. Can you paste a failing request/response and the pin config?
Alice W: here's an example request we see repeatedly — body is normal chat payload but response is a 500 with schema error: 
```
POST /v1/chat/generate
{
  "model": "os-superchat-2026-v3",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"What's the refund policy?"}]
}
```
Response snippet: 
```
500 Internal Error
{"error":"schema_mismatch", "detail":"expected 'chat' completion pipeline but routed to 'embed' variant"}
```
Ben K: That error text matches routing layer mismatch where pinned version has variant tag `embed` instead of `chat`. Looks like the build pipeline published v3 as `os-superchat-2026-v3-embed` but the pin didn't include variant intent.
Dev Runtime: pulling routing logs now. Quick check: the pin entry for AcmePayments is `model: os-superchat-2026-v3` but the model catalog maps that tag to two artifacts: `-chat` and `-embed` and the routing policy prefers the cheaper variant when exact variant unspecified. So chat requests are falling back to embed binary -> manifest mismatch -> 500.
Carol (oncall): Ok mitigation plan (short): 1) rollback pin for customer to previous stable v2, 2) temp policy override to disallow embed variant for chat routes, 3) run smoke traffic for AcmePayments. Who can apply the rollback?
Ben K: I can revert the pin. Running `redwoodctl pins set --customer acmepay --model os-superchat-2026-v2 --reason "regression rollback"` now.
Dev Runtime: I'll flip the routing flag: 
```
redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/chat/generate --disallow-variant embed
```
Carol (oncall): Oncall, please watch error rate and confirm customer health. SRE Pager, please update status page if ETA > 15m.
SRE Pager: Acknowledged. Creating incident status: "Investigating - Misrouted model variant causing chat 500s". Notifying CS.
Customer Success: Pinged AcmePayments CSM. They report a handful of support tickets and a drop in chat completions; they saw failures starting at 09:03 UTC. Asking for ETA.
Ben K: Rollback command returned OK at 09:14 UTC (1767894854). Please confirm routing change applied.
Dev Runtime: Route flag applied at 09:16 UTC (1767894962). Pushing a small canary to confirm.
Alice W: error rate down to 1.2% for AcmePayments, overall chat 500s back to baseline. Can we keep the pin reverted and do an immediate hotfix?
Ben K: Keeping pin reverted. I'm creating a patch to model catalog publish step to require explicit variant tag for any model that has >1 artifact. Will also add CI smoke check to validate chat pipeline after publication.
Carol (oncall): Good. Customer Impact: AcmePayments ~300 failed requests over peak 09:03-09:16 UTC, transient revenue impact reported. No data exfiltration. Severity remains P1 until rollback confirmed for all affected tenants.
Dev Runtime: Root cause summary: recent automated release pipeline published new model versions without tagging variant metadata correctly; pinning logic allowed ambiguous model id to resolve to cheapest compatible artifact (embed) causing incompatible runtime path.
Carol (oncall): Postmortem tasks: 1) enforce variant validation in pin API (devs), 2) add pre-pin smoke tests that run a chat request against the actual model artifact (runtime), 3) update alert runbook to include a quick query for `schema_mismatch` errors (SRE).
Ben K: Filed RFC #IR-2026-07 for catalog tagging change and PR coming in 2 hours.
SRE Pager: Closing on-call handoff — monitoring until 09:45 UTC (1767896700). If no regression, we'll move to P2 and start timeline for postmortem.
Alice W: Thanks team — appreciate the quick triage. Adding this to the weekly incidents review. :thumbsup:
